title: Strategy-lens roadmap readout with risk‑adjusted asks and scenario lanes
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Objective: Prepare a concise, scenario-driven executive readout that reframes the QBR ask from 'feature list' to 'risk‑adjusted investment lanes' so execs can choose tradeoffs across latency, cost, and reliability. This ticket scopes the narrative, asks, data artifacts, and decision framing for the Platform & Runtime QBR slot.

Key deliverables: a 6‑slide exec deck (1 summary slide + 3 scenario lanes + 1 metrics/tradeoffs + 1 decision slate), a short appendix with data snapshots (p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, utilization by model family), and an action tracker mapping asks to resourcing/$$.

Primary decision asks proposed: 
- Approve reallocation of 6 FTEs from infra to runtime optimizations for Q2 (estimated incremental impact: -18% cost per token, -120ms p95)
- Greenlight $400k limited-term budget for Dedicated capacity expansion to avoid next quarter capacity crunch in EU region
- Approve experiment runway for adaptive batching pilot (90 days) with KPI guardrails

Tradeoffs to surface: 
- Cost vs latency: default recommendation shows 2 scenarios (Conservative: prioritize reliability, Moderate: balanced, Aggressive: cost-first).
- Customer impact: show which top customers (by MRR) would be at risk under the cost-first lane.

Artifacts & owners: 
- Deck draft (owner: Liam Chen)
- Data appendix (owner: Sasha Ortiz)
- Risk heatmap & fallback plan (owner: Aisha Kapoor)
- Post-QBR action tracker (owner: Product Ops)

Success criteria: 
- Execs select one of the three lanes and sign off on the recommended funding/resourcing decisions, or request a clearly scoped follow-up within 2 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Deck reviewed by Eng/Research/Finance with updated metrics. 2) Risk lanes include clear customer impact mapping. 3) Decision slate lists owners and budget/people ask with fallback options. 4) Post-readout action tracker created and assigned.
